x1_pioneiro.name: CCL X1 Pioneiro
x1_pioneiro.authority: Main ruled the Brazil line on 2026-10-29 (DECISIONS) on the owner's request the same day ("lets build brazil, not taiwan, and flesh it out with all its own tanks"): the X1 at tier I as the Brazil tree's root, a photo-class first-party build on the Bernardini X1 family's build; no registered 3D comparison exists. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified.
x1_pioneiro.envelopeBasis: Width, length and tallest are the as-built envelope of the X1 family build (profiles/bernardiniX1.ts): published 5.04 m hull, 6.04 m over the 90 mm D-921, 2.4 m wide, 2.45 m high (Tanks Encyclopedia after Bastos' "Brazilian Stuart"); stations from Gaydos' profile. The envelope holds the pioneer tools, the .50 left of the cupola and the raked whip antenna.
